audience: Operating-business buyers and directory reviewers evaluating 8BitConcepts implementation work.
traffic_intent: Verify owned projects, inspect product documentation, and request a relevant consulting intro.
quality_metric: A real buyer describes a business workflow or technical need; exclude operator checks, crawler visits and generic forms.
scope: Owned-project case-study copy, article count markers on four existing pages, campaign capture on direct case-study arrivals and a factual share card.
observed_findings: Case study advertises API Pro pricing while current public API policy says Pro paywalling is disabled.
Paid-customer/build-time, cost comparisons and always-current operational assertions have no supporting evidence in this task.
Validated article index and manifest both contain 76 articles; evergreen headlines say 46 or 49.
Case-study landing page omits the shared attribution script.

source_evidence.observed: Current public reads are free; REST and MCP surfaces are documented.
Search, site records, readiness scoring and MCP discovery are documented.
Local setup migration, previews, snapshots and product pricing are published.
76 validated article entries, excluding directory and overview pages.

same_category_references.lesson: Keep inquiry expectations beside the next action.
Use the existing dark canvas, orange action and readable muted text roles.
Separate company identity, service description and evidence of work.

design_decisions: Retain page layout and the four existing project anchors.
Replace unsupported outcome claims with inspectable implementation descriptions and primary-source links.
Let the existing research-index build update marked article totals.
Use existing brand typography and color roles; correct action/footer contrast and keyboard focus.

evidence_classes.measured: Archive article count and observed public API policies.
evidence_classes.standard: WCAG contrast, focus and reflow requirements.
evidence_classes.observed_pattern: Primary documentation links support company/work verification.
evidence_classes.conversion_hypothesis: Clearer evidence may reduce buyer verification friction; no lift is measured.

render_conditions: First screen, full page and decision area
limits: No revenue, customer, delivery-time, universal integration or full-site accessibility claim.
Local landing-page catalog counts and research article assertions are outside this review.
